findings.summary: Toggle has no focusableWhenDisabled. Radix disabled toggles are not focusable either, so no parity gap.
No aria-pressed=mixed tri-state. Not used by m3 or Radix.
Pressed check only when value truthy (ToggleGroup context); fixed.

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blogs (only the GitHub issue search API was used; no shadcn-ui/ui issues found for base toggle)

apiChanges: Root is TogglePrimitive (not .Root); props type TogglePrimitive.Props. Consumer FormSections uses only variant/size/aria-label/defaultPressed/disabled, no edit needed.

DOM attribute data-state=on|off becomes data-pressed (present when on); data-[state=on]:bg-muted in the class is now inert but aria-pressed:bg-muted gives the same pressed style. Nothing in src selects on data-state for toggle.
Redundant tabindex=0 attribute added to the button (no behavioural change).
notes: Compared all 6 gallery toggles: tag, type=button, aria-pressed, sizes (36x32, 38x32, 73.8x28, 79.4x36), colours, radius, opacity, pointer-events and disabled attrs identical; click toggles aria-pressed and background identically; Tab + Space gives the same focus ring and toggle on both; zoomed screenshots identical. The window resize to 390x844 did not shrink the viewport (screenshots stayed ~1280 wide), so a true 390px render was not checked; toggle is intrinsic inline-flex with identical classes and measured sizes. Mixed state: toggle-group stays Radix and imports only toggleVariants. check:theme also passes.
